title: The Billionaire’s Regret
description: He left her with nothing. Five years later, she owns the company he needs.

seasons.title: The Reunion
seasons.description: Five years was a long time to plan a revenge.

parts.text: He walked into the boardroom, expecting to meet the new CEO. He didn't expect to see her.
She didn't look like the girl he had abandoned in the rain. She looked like a queen on her throne.
"Hello, Adrian," she said, her voice steady and cold. "I believe you're here to ask for my help."
